findings.title: ML Model Integration Timeline Not Explicit
findings.issue: The design specifies three phases for ML model implementation but doesn't provide clear criteria for moving between phases.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit activation criteria with measurable gates (e.g., ≥5000 historical matches, Brier score < 0.23, inference latency < 100ms).

findings.title: Dixon-Coles Rho Parameter Training Not Specified
findings.issue: The design provides default rho values (-0.13) and mentions league-specific rho but doesn't specify how to calculate/train league-specific rho parameters.
findings.recommendation: Add rho estimation procedure using maximum likelihood estimation with grid search over candidate values [-0.20, -0.05].

findings.title: Replacement Quality Estimation Underspecified
findings.issue: The design uses position-based default replacement quality (0.5-0.7) but doesn't specify how to calculate actual replacement quality when backup player data is available.
findings.recommendation: Specify data-driven replacement quality calculation: quality = replacement_contribution / unavailable_contribution, with fallback to position defaults.

findings.title: Calibration Failure Recovery Not Specified
findings.issue: The design specifies calibration methods and validation (ECE < 0.10) but doesn't specify what happens when calibration fails validation.
findings.recommendation: Add calibration failure handling: reject calibrator if ECE > 0.15, use identity calibrator (no adjustment) as fallback.

findings.title: Confidence Tier Thresholds Not Fully Justified
findings.issue: The design specifies confidence tier thresholds (HIGH: prob > 0.55, MEDIUM: prob > 0.65) but doesn't provide mathematical or empirical justification.
findings.recommendation: Add justification based on expected value calculations with typical bookmaker margins (5-10%), and note that thresholds should be validated through backtesting.

assessment.integration_verification: All assumptions verified against actual code
